observations.statement: An unhandled promise rejection reports a payment gateway timeout from captureAsync
captureAsync starts payments.capture with void and returns the order as paid without awaiting it

hypotheses.summary: captureAsync in checkout.ts fires payments.capture in the background without awaiting or catching it, so a gateway timeout becomes an unhandled rejection while the order is already reported as paid.
hypotheses.confidence_rationale: The stack names captureAsync and the code shows the unawaited call and the early paid status.
